SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAY-03-2017 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF MAY-03-2017 BY JUDGE PRO TEM DIANNE PEEBLES. THE COURT DISMISSES ERLINA VALERIO AS A DEFENDANT AND AMENDS THE COMPLAINT TO ADD COX AND KING GLOBAL SERVIES USA, LLC AS THE DEFENDANT. PLAINTIFF SHINO THOMAS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT COX AND KING GLOBAL SERVIES USA, LLC IS PRESENT. REPRESNTED BY ROCKY RIKHI, HEAD OF OPERATIONS. DEFENDANT COX AND KING GLOBAL SERVIES USA, LLC WAIVES SERIVICE OF THE CLAIM. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DIANNE PEEBLES; CLERK: J. MURPHY; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-03-2017 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. REMARK: RETURNED MAIL: NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT MAILED TO ERLINA VALERIO ON 5/18/17. PER U.S. POSTAL SERVICE, "RETURN TO SENDER-INSUFFICIENT ADDRESS-UNABLE TO FORWARD."
